snippet.title: SPiNG | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Experience the zen and skilful world of SP!NG, for the first time on Steam! The previously-Apple Arcade exclusive from renowned Aussie developer SMG Studio is bringing its meditative and joyful one-button swinging experience to a whole new audience on June 18th.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246100/SPiNG/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
